answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 28162 Country: India Title: Respected pious scholar ,1) Is skin tight pajami and jeans but covers the legs are allowed in islam?? If I wear loose pajami & jeans with frock below knees(with head scarf)...Will this dress be allowed in islam?? Question: Assalaamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuhu!! Respected pious scholar ,1) Is skin tight pajami and jeans but covers the legs are allowed in islam?? If I wear loose pajami & jeans with frock below knees(with head scarf)...Will this dress be allowed in islam?? Answer ID: 28162 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 58/48/H=1432) (1) It is not lawful. (2) It, too, is not lawful. The dress should be loose and simple. And its style should resemble that of the dress of pious women. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
